title: California National Guardsmen Deploy to Support Hurricane Harvey Response
description: California Air National Guardsmen from the 129th Rescue Wing, Moffett Air National Guard Base, Calif., prepare to board a C-130J aircraft from the 146th Airlift Wing, Channel Island Air National Guard Station, Calif., in support of Hurricane Harvey, August 28, 2017.  The 129th Rescue Wing plans to deploy approximately 90 of its unit members, including highly trained Guardian Angel pararescuemen to Texas to provide search and rescue support for the victims of Hurricane Harvey. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Master Sgt. Ray Aquino)
